collection.title: Information We Collect
collection.content: We collect information you provide directly, such as your name, phone number, and delivery address when you place an order. We also collect order history and preferences to improve your experience. Device information, location data (with your consent), and usage data may be collected automatically to provide and enhance our services.

usage.title: How We Use Your Information
usage.content: Your information is used to process and deliver orders, communicate order status updates, provide customer support, and improve our menu and services. We may also send occasional promotional messages if you have opted in. Your data is never sold to third parties.

cookies.title: Cookies & Tracking
cookies.content: We use essential cookies and similar technologies to ensure the proper functioning of our ordering platform. Analytics cookies help us understand how you use the app so we can improve it. You can control cookie preferences through your device settings.

thirdParties.title: Third-Party Services
thirdParties.content: We rely on trusted third-party services for payment processing (Stripe), SMS notifications, push notifications, and analytics. These providers are contractually bound to protect your data and may only process it in accordance with our instructions.

rights.title: Your Rights
rights.content: You have the right to access, correct, or delete your personal data at any time. You may opt out of marketing communications, disable location tracking, or request data portability. To exercise these rights, contact us via the app or visit the restaurant.

general.title: General Terms
general.content: By placing an order through our app, you agree to these Terms & Conditions. All orders are subject to availability and confirmation. We reserve the right to refuse or cancel any order for legitimate reasons, including suspected fraud or errors in pricing.

orders.title: Placing Orders
orders.content: Orders are considered confirmed once you receive an order confirmation. It is your responsibility to ensure all order details are correct before submission. Modifications after confirmation may not always be possible; please contact the restaurant directly.

payments.title: Payments & Pricing
payments.content: All prices are displayed in Euro (€) and include applicable taxes. Payment can be made by cash on pickup/delivery or by card through Stripe. Your card details are processed securely by Stripe and are never stored on our servers.

delivery.title: Delivery & Pickup
delivery.content: Delivery times are estimates and may vary based on order volume and traffic conditions. We deliver within our designated delivery zones only. For pickup orders, please arrive at the selected time to ensure freshness.

cancellations.title: Cancellations & Refunds
cancellations.content: Orders can be cancelled only if preparation has not yet begun. To cancel, please contact the restaurant as soon as possible. Refunds are processed at our discretion and may take 3-5 business days for card payments.

liability.title: Limitation of Liability
liability.content: Our liability is limited to the value of the order placed. We are not liable for delays caused by circumstances beyond our control, including but not limited to weather, traffic, or technical issues. We are not responsible for food quality once it leaves our premises.
